info.title: QualityGuard CLI
info.description: Executable entry point of QualityGuard for pipeline jobs: scan, evaluate the Quality Gate and exit with 0 PASSED / 1 FAILED / 2 error.

options.name: --path
options.description:
file or directory; directories are scanned to the bottom, including every
subfolder. Repeat the option or separate values with commas to scan several.

options.name: --include
options.description: only scan files matching this glob (repeatable, e.g. --include "src/**/*.cs").

options.name: --exclude
options.description:
skip files or directories matching this glob (repeatable).
--max-file-kb skip files larger than this (default 2048).

options.name: --all-files
options.description:
keep the build, dependency and generated files that are skipped by default
(bin, obj, node_modules, vendor, dist, *.min.js, *.designer.cs, …).

options.name: --coverage
options.description:
coverage report from the test runner (LCOV, Cobertura or JaCoCo). Repeatable:
reports from every test shard are merged. Test files are excluded by default.

options.name: --base
options.description:
base branch/commit/tag that new code is measured against. When given with
--coverage, the new_* coverage metrics are computed from git on the lines the
current branch actually changed, instead of being left empty.

options.name: --by-folder
options.description: summary table of files, ncloc and issues per directory.

options.name: --new-code
options.description: derive the new_* rating metrics from the issues and evaluate them in the gate.

options.name: --fix-hints
options.description: print the fix guidance of every reported rule.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: per-file metrics, flow steps and what the scan skipped.

options.name: --rules
options.description: list loaded rules and description coverage.
